purpose_context: Two identical decision opens running at the same time can each record an opening, which leaves the decision unreadable and doctor unable to repair it. This mission makes the opening record single, lets existing duplicated logs read again, and takes the reopen rule from the shared events package.
purpose_tldr: Every decision has exactly one opening record in its event log, and the log stays readable.
contracts_rationale: Internal concurrency and read-side fold fix; no CLI, API or wire interface changes.
